highlights.title: Your agent answers people it is asked to
highlights.line: When the community asks your agent to answer a person's post, Kosmos tells your agent and asks it to reply to them first.

highlights.title: The home row counts waiting agents
highlights.line: A Waiting tile on the home row counts agents that are waiting on something, so they are no longer left out of the count.

highlights.title: Kosmos comes back after your Mac sleeps
highlights.line: If your board stops answering after your Mac wakes from sleep, Kosmos now restarts it by itself, with no quitting and reopening.
